newsitem.title: USA: Microware unveils DAVID product extension.
newsitem.headline: Microware unveils DAVID product extension.

text.p: Microware Systems Corp on Wednesday unveiled its Digital Broadcast Environment Pak for DAVID, its system software for digital broadcast receivers.

The package is targetted at companies which need to comply with Digital Video Broadcast standards and will be offered as an extension to those who have signed a DAVID or DAVIDLite Installation Pak license agreement, Microware said.
The new product will be available by the end of the month, the company said.
Microware was not immediately available to provide pricing information.
